## Reuse without additional location images

Apply these changes only when composing the relevant manuscript image. This section adds no generation IDs or mandatory full-background images.

### Entrance paving and cart (Images 001)

Crop the near-left paving and parked empty cart for low character compositions. Keep the handle and cart location consistent; do not make a new entrance location.

### Lift car positions and loading (Images 002–004)

Use the established street, shaft or lower-store angle. For the initial downward look, the car stays at 0 above the crop while the cart waits on the −8 landing. Later change the single car between the required 0, −5, −8 and −3 positions; add the helper and supply cart when required. Open or close the appropriate gate locally. Do not generate a full set of almost identical shaft backgrounds.

### Upper controller states (Images 005)

Hide or reveal the thin −2 card, change the selected movement cards, clear the last-change window or change HOLD locally. Keep the controller’s physical layout fixed. A +2 card is never inserted for the cancel action.

### Catch release (Images 007 with 002)

Keep the four −2 settings. The subsequent state turns both red warnings off, closes the lower cover and opens the street gate; the car remains at 0. Apply those local changes to the established landing image.

### Timing intermediate positions (Images 008–009)

Raise blue alone or gold alone with its lamp, keeping the bird at the start. For the common opening, use card/counter 12 and both catches raised while the platform is still at the start; then use 009 for the completed forward stop. These are local mechanism edits, not new locations.

### Kits and arch supports (Images 010–012 and 024)

Closed kit boxes and the handover use the same bench. The exact eight-part sample is 011. If an assembled head is needed, three existing rings mount the three lenses and two existing rings secure its supports. Add no extra counted parts. Higher supports belong on the existing arches. Their fitting states are local equipment changes.

### Hook matching and dispatch (Images 012–014)

The full matching is 348→4, 355→5, 414→9, 525→25. A temporary four-card arrangement may be edited from 012; the original 25 card is then removed as in 013. Quantities and quotients belong in the separate manuscript record, not extra rack signs. Remove dispatched cartons locally while keeping the rack.

### Mirror handling and reflection (Images 015–018)

Use 016 for the empty-frame and loose-tile work. A close crop can show one loose tile without creating another alcove image. Use 017 with one final cell temporarily empty for the last-tile moment; remove exactly one tile from the finished grid rather than changing its divisions. Character reflections are added according to 018’s actual camera and fixed mirror plane.

### Cube building (Images 019–020)

Build intermediate layers from the established square base. One layer has 16 cubes in a 4 × 4 arrangement; the complete block has four such layers. The manuscript’s exact layer plans remain teaching/record graphics, not extra environment requests. Change top-frame fastening locally.

### Readiness lights and handle (Images 021)

Use one board design. Light order is none; LIFT; LIFT plus RHYTHM; first three; first four; all five. Lit readiness lamps are white. Handle raised or down is a local pose change. All five white lights can coexist with dark arches and an unrepaired joint. Image 021 includes a completed cube edge. For any moment before the cube repair, crop that edge out while retaining the wall and canopy anchors, or replace it with the uneven-tower state from Image 019. Changing only the lamps is insufficient.

### Joint cover and power (Images 020, 022–024)

A closed crooked cover hides the gap. After the open repair, close the same cover flush. Keep the track unlit until its powered state, then make the existing line continuous. Do not substitute a second switch or illuminate an open gap.

### Restored street and threshold (Images 024 and 027)

Use 024 for street celebration backgrounds and modest crops. A locally relit 001 supplies any needed forward view. Use 027 with its original shutter fully lowered for a closer closed-threshold background; then return to the raised-shutter state. Keep Food Street’s cart and bowls uncorrected.

### Teaching companion scenery (Images 002, 010, 012, 016, 019–021)

Reuse the relevant wall, lamp, bench, frame, canopy or plinth fragments. Preserve the current equipment state and crop out answers that are not yet available. Soft scenic boundaries are applied during page composition; they do not require separate full location images. When reusing Image 021 before the cube is completed, exclude its completed cube edge or restore the earlier unsolved state.

### Gate waiting views (Images 026)

Crop the Gate foreground for visitor groups and invitation details. Keep the bright round ornament and closed main leaves. An invitation held by a character is a prop close-up, not a separate location.
